episodes.synopsis: The more things change, the more they stay the same. Coconna and Vanilla take a trip down memory lane by returning to where their story first began.
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Cloud

episodes.synopsis: Despite Pol’s best efforts, Kummen plunged into war once again. By the time Chirico’s friends arrive, the government has erupted into a full-blown coup d’état.
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Cumene

episodes.synopsis: Zophie once bore a vendetta against Chirico. Now an old woman, she takes in a stranger, but what will she do when she discovers who he really is?
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Sansa

episodes.synopsis: Plots take shape as word spreads about the "Child of God" and people realize the fate of the galaxy is at stake. Chirico must escort the child to the Tower of Gomor.
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Nurugeranto

episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Shako find themselves deep beneath the surface and in the company of a mysterious girl who warns them about the Doyo.
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Cocoon

episodes.synopsis: Forces converge above the planet. Chirico soldiers on, determined to rescue the child entrusted to him, and once again faces an important choice.
episodes.title: Phantom Arc: Infanti
